en: The Training Rule on Walking Behind.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were walking behind while teaching the Dhamma to one walking in front... [as before] ...
"The training is to be observed: 'I will not teach the Dhamma to one who is not ill while walking in front, when I am walking behind.
One walking behind must not teach the Dhamma to one walking in front who is not ill."
If, out of disrespect, one who is walking behind gives a teaching to one who is walking ahead and is not ill, there is an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first-time offender.
The eleventh training rule is concluded.
